assessment.summary: Both retained settings have 2 demonstrations and 4 distinct queries; public files contain no query labels, and changing private seed/setting/query answers leaves exact public bytes and IDs unchanged. The writer still creates public files inside the seed-index loop before final batch ordering; stage records and write by sorted public ID in a follow-up.

boundary: public/private identity under private seed, setting, and query-answer mutation
limitations: This probe checks retained files and private-only mutations; it does not rerun Racket labels.
Physical write order is established by source inspection, not filesystem timestamp evidence.
Passing this privacy boundary does not approve the proposed ring_order variant or production integration.
